big_picture.title: Stock Market Hit Again As Nvidia, Chip Stocks Cast Pall On Nasdaq And AI Trade
big_picture.excerpt: The stock market made another leg down Monday as sentiment stayed negative in chip in AI stocks ahead of Anthropic's IPO debut Thursday.
paragraphs: An ornery stock market woke up from where it left off last week as more unsettling losses in the chip sector Monday unleashed another wave of selling in the Nasdaq composite.

After closing one point below its 200-day moving average Friday, the Nasdaq composite swooned 2.5%. The Nasdaq 100 fell 2.7%, weighed down by weakness in Astera Labs (ALAB) and Lumentum (LITE), each of which slumped nearly 9%. Memory and storage stocks like Sandisk (SNDK) and Micron (MU) fell roughly 8% apiece.
